clips.title: The story
paras: Jangolode Mine is a rich mineral excavation located in the rolling hills of Westfall. Once a vital source of ore and raw materials for Stormwind City, the mine has been seized by the bandits of the Defias Brotherhood.

Before Westfall fell into decline, the Jangolode Mine provided a steady flow of metals crucial to the reconstruction and supply of Stormwind City. As civil order deteriorated and the kingdom withdrew its garrisons, the Defias Brotherhood seized control of the site to feed their own operations. The bandits now work the rich veins for themselves, fiercely defending their subterranean prize.
